description: Update [cvrt] Media settings; omitted keys keep their value, and nothing is stored when any value is invalid. github_token is write-only: it is never returned, and a blank value keeps the stored token. To remove the token pass clear_github_token: true explicitly.

backup_retention_days.description: Days to keep backups of originals before automatic cleanup, 0..3650

clear_github_token.description: true removes the stored GitHub token

github_token.description: GitHub token for plugin updates. Write-only; blank keeps the stored token

keep_copyright.description: Keep the copyright field when stripping metadata

max_dimension.description: Longest side in px; 0 disables resizing, otherwise 320..10000

optimize_on_upload.description: Optimize new uploads in the background queue

output_format.description: webp_avif (WebP main, AVIF extra), webp, or keep (original format)

remove_data_on_uninstall.description: Delete plugin data when the plugin is deleted

name: media_update_settings
